Synopsis:
Baelan, a mushroom hunter,  is surrounded by dangeous Bibberbang mushrooms. He was trying to get to the Noblestalk mushroom, but one of the stone ledges collapsed underneath him and he fell down. His partner Derryth (Dwarven Alchemist) is in the Myconid Village. Important: Baelan seems to have trouble keeping his train of thought - he loses track of his responses, changes the subject and generally seems out of sorts at times. Later, it will be confirmed that he's been suffering from a dementia-like condition for some years now.

Cluster Contexts:
- UND_MushroomHunter.json: Baelen Bonecloak is a disoriented mushroom hunter who fell when a stone ledge collapsed while he was reaching for a Noblestalk; he is now surrounded by volatile bibberbang mushrooms and urgently trying not to set them off. His partner Derryth Bonecloak, a gruff Dwarven alchemist who runs Bonecloak’s in Baldur’s Gate, is off in the Myconid Village trying to secure or sell a Noblestalk to keep their shop afloat and is quietly very worried about Baelen. Baelen frequently loses his train of thought, repeats himself, and becomes panicked or distracted, which explains the stilted, urgent lines and sudden topic changes; he also believes his bag (and a Misty Step scroll) has been dropped somewhere nearby. Off‑screen facts that affect the scene include whether the player already has or offers a Misty Step scroll (or a Noblestalk or other valuables), any prior deals or betrayals with the myconids, and earlier reports about Baelen’s condition—all of which shape Derryth’s reactions and the player’s dialogue options.
- UND_MushroomHunter_AD_Alone.json: Baelen sits in the Myconid Circle, talking to himself. He narrowly escaped being blown up by a field of mushrooms with the help of the player. He may react to his wife Derryth being dead, and may also have his wits returned to him after eating the noblestalk mushroom.These comments loop.
- UND_MushroomHunter_Dead.json: Baelen was out hunting Noblestalk when he was trapped in a field of explosive mushrooms. He's now dead - most likely because the player triggered those mushrooms to explode. He speaks in short, cryptic fragments from beyond the grave.
- UND_MushroomHunter_AD_HunterThanksPlayer.json: Baelen has escaped a field of explosive bibberbang mushrooms, thanks to the player's help.
- UND_MyconidSovereign.json: Main dialogue with creepy myconid sovereign. He wants you to kill some duergar that are left from when they attacked these mushroom creatures. Myconids are part of a "circle", kind of a hive mind. They speak in visions, with music - all telepathically. This should be otherworldly and slightly disturbing.
